description: This file declares the WifiManagerState class, which provides methods to get the current WiFi state, retrieve the connected SSID, and enable or disable the WiFi feature within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WifiManagerState
classes.description: A class that manages WiFi state operations such as retrieving current state, connected SSID, and enabling/disabling WiFi.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected WiFi network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables WiFi based on provided parameters.
